answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware attestation key sealed inside a physical secure enclave, so one identity requires one real chip — copper traces and silicon, not a copied file. The enclave signs a fresh pulse heartbeat every epoch, proving the same device is still live, and a failed or duplicated heartbeat revokes the identity. At the summit of the trust chain, independent auditors sample attestations and slash any operator caught cloning keys. Forging a thousand Sybils then means buying a thousand chips and keeping them all powered, turning a free copy-paste attack into a hardware bill.
